decisions.reason: The compact modular trommel screen builds on the established BASIC 518 trommel line that the firm publicly praised, so trommel screening is central to its portfolio and its sunk development costs favor continuing it.

Its website presence shrank from a page of its own in 2018 to a mere mention in 2019, a sign of weakening commitment, but the investment in a multi-model line and the chance to blame weak results on temporary market conditions still favor keeping it for now.

Its visibility rose to a page of its own in 2019, and the firm already dropped the overlapping green-waste grinder E, which leaves this multi-model grinder line as its committed high-speed grinding offering.

The single-shaft pre-shredder line is visibly committed, documented in a reported plant installation, and central to the firm's stated push toward tougher stationary recycling solutions, so dropping it is unlikely.
